title: Lot 6 — Malema–Gandorhun Trunk Road
alt: Sierra Leone Roads Authority project signboard naming Blue-Ray as contractor for Lot 6
narrative: The Government of Sierra Leone awarded Blue-Ray Lot 6 of the nationwide Major and Minor Regravelling Works programme — 40 lots in total — covering the 37-kilometre Malema–Gandorhun (Sefadu) trunk road. The project signboard on site names Blue-Ray as the contractor, with the Ministry of Finance financing the work and the Sierra Leone Roads Authority supervising it.

facts.label: Programme
facts.value: Major & Minor Regravelling Works, 40 lots nationwide

title: 24-Metre Reinforced Concrete Bridge, Bendu Junction
alt: The completed 24-metre reinforced concrete bridge at Bendu Junction
narrative: A full reinforced concrete bridge delivered on the Bendu Junction – Bendu Mameima route, including abutments, deck, approach embankments and backfilled pavement either side. The crossing replaced a seasonal bottleneck that cut communities off during the rains.

title: Sumbuya–Tormabum Corridor Rehabilitation
alt: The rehabilitated and cambered gravel surface of the Sumbuya to Tormabum corridor
narrative: Gravel rehabilitation of the Sumbuya–Tormabum corridor for the Sierra Leone Roads Authority: side-brushing of the right of way, re-cambering for drainage, and compaction to a finished gravel surface. Related works along Tihun–Khaleh added reinforced culverts and backfilled crossings.

title: Heavy Mineral Concentrate Processing Plant
alt: A multi-level spiral concentrator plant separating heavy mineral sands
narrative: Commissioning of a spiral concentrator bank for gravity separation of heavy mineral sands. Feed is pumped from the working face, separated across multiple spiral stages, and stockpiled as saleable concentrate. It is the company's most capital-intensive mining asset and the clearest demonstration of in-country processing capability.

title: Bauxite Export — Vessel Loading
alt: Grab cranes loading bauxite ore into the hold of a bulk carrier
narrative: Bauxite mined, stockpiled and hauled by Blue-Ray loaded into bulk carriers for export. Completing the chain from pit face to ship's hold — excavation, stockpile management, haulage and vessel loading — is what separates a mining contractor from a trader.

title: Steel Maintenance Workshop & Industrial Buildings
alt: A large steel-framed maintenance workshop with full fit-out
narrative: An industrial-grade steel structure delivered with full electrical fit-out, alongside an administrative office block, control building, security post and generator house, perimeter fencing and worker dormitory — a complete site build rather than a single structure.

title: Incorporated as an Indigenous Premier Company
alt: The Blue-Ray site team standing with a wheel loader
narrative: Blue-Ray (SL) Ltd. was incorporated and registered with the Government of the Republic of Sierra Leone in 2016 as a Premier Company, on the conviction that Sierra Leone's infrastructure should be built by Sierra Leoneans, backed by the best partners available internationally.
